metadata.title: Arm CEO Rene Haas has been talked up as a possible replacement for Jensen Huang - MarketWatch

content.text:
Nov. 12, 10:16am ET
Arm CEO Rene Haas has been talked up as a possible replacement for Jensen Huang
Nvidia's board is looking at both internal and external candidates to replace Jensen Huang as CEO, and the leader of Arm Holdings has been floated as a compelling option.
Arm CEO Rene Haas spent seven years at Nvidia from 2006 to 2013, "and understands Jensen’s culture," Shay Boloor, chief market strategist at The Futurum Group, said in emailed comments shared with MarketWatch.
Additionally, Nvidia's central processing units run on Arm architecture, he said. Nvidia is newer to the CPU game but has big expectations for that market given the rising importance of these chips.
